court: In the High Court of Madras
judges_raw: (Before Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J. and G. Arul Murugan, J.)
appellants: Abirami Engineering Construction and Co. Rep by A Partner Cum Authorised Signatory … Appellant(s);
respondents: Government of Tamilnadu Rep by Secretary, Public Work Department and Others … Respondent(s).
advocates: For Respondent(s): Mr. R. Veeramani Government Pleader
prayer: PRAYER: appeal filed under Clause 15 of the letters patent to set aside the order dated 28-1-2026 passed by the learned Single Judge in WP No. 22405 of 2025
judgment_text:
The Judgment of the Court was delivered by

Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J.:— The judgment dated 16-6-2026 passed by this Court in a connected appeal, being W.A. No. 1530 of 2026, squarely governs the issue that has been raised in this appeal. By the said judgment, the challenge made by the appellant to the order passed by the learned Single Judge awarding 10% interest was rejected.

2. This appeal is dismissed in terms of the judgment dated 16-6-2026 passed in W.A. No. 1530 of 2026. There shall be no order as to costs.
